title: Zooming without Zooming v2: From Seeing Details to Connecting Evidence for Generalizable Multimodal Perception
title_zh: 无缩放的缩放v2：从观察细节到连接证据，实现可泛化的多模态感知

paragraphs.en: Multimodal perception forms the foundation of multimodal intelligence. In particular, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding are two pivotal tasks that underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents. However, synthesizing targeted, high-quality training data for these tasks remains difficult and costly. Our key insight is that these tasks share an underlying capability, which we call connecting evidence: identifying relevant visual facts, binding them to the correct entities, recovering their relations, and composing them into an answer. Crucially, targeted training data are far easier to synthesize for this capability than for these tasks themselves. To strengthen this capability, we propose EvidenceConnect , an easy-to-implement data synthesis framework that uses zoomed views of related regions within a single image to generate questions requiring comparison, aggregation, or chaining of visual evidence. To ensure quality, a reference answer is retained only when independent VLMs agree on it, and region-ablation tests discard questions whose answer survives the removal of selected regions. We then train base VLMs on the resulting data with RLVR, obtaining Zooming without Zooming v2 (ZwZ2). Although the synthesized data are not tailored to any downstream benchmark, ZwZ2 improves fine-grained and spatial perception, with further gains on embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal long-context understanding, multimodal agent tasks, and general visual reasoning (shown in Figure 1 ). These results establish EvidenceConnect as an effective framework for supervising evidence connection and suggest that strengthening this shared capability leads to more generalizable multimodal perception.

paragraphs.en: Multimodal perception is the foundation of multimodal intelligence: before a multimodal model can reason or act, it must determine what is present in a scene. Recent progress on this front, such as multimodal Chain-of-Thought ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Li and Ma, 2026 ) and Thinking-with-Images ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ) , has improved the ability of open-source vision-language models (VLMs) to perceive fine-grained visual content and use it in reasoning ( Wei et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 多模态感知是多模态智能的基础：在多模态模型能够推理或行动之前，它必须先确定场景中存在什么。 这方面的最新进展，例如多模态思维链（Zhang et al., 2023；Xu et al., 2024；Li and Ma, 2026）和“以图像思考”（Zheng et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025c），提升了开源视觉语言模型（VLM）感知细粒度视觉内容并将其用于推理的能力（Wei et al., 2026；Wei et al., 2025b；Li et al., 2026b）。

paragraphs.en: However, these advances do not reliably extend to tasks in which critical visual cues are dispersed across objects, relationships, frames, or dialogue turns. Two such tasks, spatial perception and multimodal long-context understanding, are particularly important because they underpin embodied AI and multimodal agents, respectively. Spatial perception requires a model to recover how entities are arranged relative to one another and how several spatial relations compose ( Gemini Robotics Team, 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ) . Embodied AI relies on it to ground navigation, manipulation, and viewpoint-dependent decisions in object locations and spatial relations ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Multimodal long-context understanding requires a model to locate evidence across images and dialogue history, preserve entity identity, and bring that evidence to bear on the current question ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025d ; Song et al., 2024 ) . Multimodal agents rely on it to retrieve relevant past observations, resolve references across interactions, and integrate earlier evidence into current decisions ( He et al., 2024 ; Su et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些进展并不能可靠地推广到那些关键视觉线索分散于不同对象、关系、帧或对话轮次中的任务。 空间感知与多模态长上下文理解是其中两类特别重要的任务，因为它们分别是具身智能和多模态智能体的基础。 空间感知要求模型恢复实体之间彼此相对的排布方式，以及多个空间关系如何组合（Gemini Robotics Team, 2025; Li et al., 2025a）。 具身智能依靠空间感知，将导航、操作以及依赖视点的决策建立在对象位置和空间关系之上（Brohan et al., 2023; Kim et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2026）。 多模态长上下文理解要求模型在图像和对话历史中定位证据、保持实体身份的一致，并将这些证据用于回答当前问题（Wu et al., 2025; Liu et al., 2024; Wang et al., 2025d; Song et al., 2024）。 多模态智能体依靠多模态长上下文理解来检索相关的过往观察、解析跨交互的指代，并将较早的证据融入当前决策（He et al., 2024; Su et al., 2026; Li et al., 2025b）。

paragraphs.en: Strengthening these capabilities, however, is constrained by the difficulty of building high-quality training data. For spatial perception, existing efforts mainly scale up region-grounded relational data ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , but reliable labels require precise localization and relational grounding across multiple objects. Such labels are expensive to annotate by hand, while automated generators often hallucinate relations. For long-context understanding, existing multi-image and multi-turn instruction data ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) concentrate on a few formats and task types, because diverse questions that remain answerable over long sequences are hard to construct automatically. Data for embodied spatial reasoning and multimodal agents are even harder to synthesize, since they additionally involve physical or interactive environments and multi-step trajectories. Consequently, neither these capabilities nor the applications built on them have a scalable and high-quality source of clean, verifiable supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些能力的提升受到构建高质量训练数据困难的制约。 在空间感知方面，现有工作主要扩展基于区域的关系型数据（Chen et al., 2024a；Zhang et al., 2026a），但可靠的标签需要对多个对象进行精确定位和关系接地。 这类标签人工标注成本高昂，而自动化生成器又常常产生幻觉性关系。 在长上下文理解方面，现有的多图像和多轮指令数据（Jiang et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2024）集中于少数格式和任务类型，因为要在长序列上仍可回答的多样化问题很难自动构建。 具身空间推理和多模态智能体的数据更难合成，因为它们还涉及物理或交互式环境以及多步轨迹。 因此，这些能力以及构建于其上的应用，都缺乏可扩展且高质量的干净、可验证的监督来源。

paragraphs.en: Our key insight is that these tasks build on a shared atomic capability of VLMs, which we call connecting evidence : identifying task-relevant visual facts, binding each fact to the correct entity, recovering the relations among them, and integrating the evidence into an answer. These tasks instantiate this capability differently: spatial perception connects objects within a scene through spatial relations, whereas long-context understanding, on which multimodal agents rely, connects facts across images and dialogue turns through entity identity and reference. Despite these differences in where the evidence resides and how it is linked, both tasks rely on the same underlying steps, so strengthening these steps can benefit both. Moreover, since the first step, identifying visual facts, is itself fine-grained perception, fine-grained perception benefits as well.

paragraphs.en: Crucially, training data that target this capability are far easier to construct and verify than data for the tasks themselves. To turn this insight into trainable supervision, we propose EvidenceConnect , an easy-to-implement, fully automated framework that synthesizes visual questions requiring the model to connect evidence across regions. Specifically, we select a group of related regions within a single image and synthesize a compositional question over them from privileged zoomed views, which make small details visible but are used only during data construction. Depending on the scene, we synthesize questions to compare, aggregate, or chain evidence across the regions. Answering such questions thus exercises the same steps as the target tasks: relating regions spatially, including from a given viewpoint, parallels spatial perception and embodied spatial reasoning, whereas locating scattered regions, binding their facts to the right references, and integrating them parallels long-context understanding and multimodal agents. To ensure data quality, we keep a question only if VLMs from different families agree on its answer, and we use region-ablation tests to discard questions whose answer survives the removal of selected regions. Finally, each verified question is converted into multiple-choice form for rule-based rewards and paired with the full image, where colored outlines typically mark the selected regions to avoid ambiguous references, so the model must still perceive and connect the evidence by itself.
paragraphs.zh: 至关重要的是，针对这一能力构建的训练数据比针对任务本身构建的数据要容易构造和验证得多。 为了将这一洞察转化为可训练的监督信号，我们提出了 EvidenceConnect，一个易于实现、完全自动化的框架，用于合成要求模型跨区域连接证据的视觉问题。 具体而言，我们在单张图像内选取一组相关区域，并利用特权放大视图在其上合成一个组合式问题；这些放大视图使小细节变得可见，但仅在数据构建阶段使用。 根据场景的不同，我们合成的问题会对这些区域间的证据进行比较、聚合或串联。 因此，回答此类问题所经历的步骤与目标任务相同：在空间上关联区域（包括从给定视角出发）对应空间感知与具身空间推理，而定位分散的区域、将其事实绑定到正确的指代对象并加以整合，则对应长上下文理解与多模态智能体。 为确保数据质量，只有当来自不同家族的视觉语言模型对答案达成一致时，我们才保留该问题；同时我们使用区域消融测试，剔除那些在移除所选区域后答案仍然成立的问题。 最后，每个经过验证的问题都会被转换为选择题形式以便基于规则的奖励，并与完整图像配对；图像中通常用彩色轮廓标记所选区域以避免指代不明确，因此模型仍须自行感知并连接证据。

sents.zh: 因此，回答此类问题所经历的步骤与目标任务相同：在空间上关联区域（包括从给定视角出发）对应空间感知与具身空间推理，而定位分散的区域、将其事实绑定到正确的指代对象并加以整合，则对应长上下文理解与多模态智能体。

sents.en: To ensure data quality, we keep a question only if VLMs from different families agree on its answer, and we use region-ablation tests to discard questions whose answer survives the removal of selected regions.
sents.zh: 为确保数据质量，只有当来自不同家族的视觉语言模型对答案达成一致时，我们才保留该问题；同时我们使用区域消融测试，剔除那些在移除所选区域后答案仍然成立的问题。

sents.en: Finally, each verified question is converted into multiple-choice form for rule-based rewards and paired with the full image, where colored outlines typically mark the selected regions to avoid ambiguous references, so the model must still perceive and connect the evidence by itself.
sents.zh: 最后，每个经过验证的问题都会被转换为选择题形式以便基于规则的奖励，并与完整图像配对；图像中通常用彩色轮廓标记所选区域以避免指代不明确，因此模型仍须自行感知并连接证据。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether this supervision generalizes beyond the synthesized questions, we train Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.5-9B, and Qwen3.6-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ; Qwen Team, 2026b ) with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) ( Lambert et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) using only our synthesized data, without supervised fine-tuning or benchmark-specific question formats. The resulting models, ZwZ2-4B/9B/27B, achieve substantial improvements in fine-grained and spatial perception as well as multimodal long-context understanding, with gains that further extend to embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal agent tasks, and general visual reasoning. For example, ZwZ2-4B improves over its base model from 37.43 to 45.26 (+7.83) on ViewSpatial-Bench (spatial reasoning) and from 60.08 to 70.08 (+10.00) on MileBench (long-context understanding). More broadly, its average over all 25 benchmarks increases from 49.41 to 54.79, and the corresponding averages improve from 51.63 to 56.59 for ZwZ2-9B and from 55.52 to 60.51 for ZwZ2-27B. Notably, although ZwZ2 is trained only on single images, it also improves on multi-image long-context benchmarks and multimodal agent tasks. These results demonstrate that connecting evidence is indeed a generalizable training target for multimodal perception.

paragraphs.en: To summarize, our key contributions are the following:
paragraphs.zh: 综上所述，我们的主要贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We identify connecting evidence as an important atomic capability of VLMs, underlying fine-grained perception, spatial perception, and multimodal long-context understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将连接证据识别为视觉语言模型（VLM）的一项重要原子能力，它是细粒度感知、空间感知和多模态长上下文理解的基础。

paragraphs.en: We develop EvidenceConnect , a structured and audited synthesis pipeline for single-image, multi-region compositional questions, with privileged region views and independent checks for answer correctness and evidence dependence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 EvidenceConnect，一个面向单图像、多区域组合问题的结构化且可审计的综合流水线，它利用特权区域视图，并对答案正确性与证据依赖性进行独立校验。

paragraphs.en: Experiments demonstrate that RLVR on the resulting synthetic data improves a broad range of perception benchmarks and further generalizes to many real-world tasks, including embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal agent tasks, and general visual reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 实验表明，在由此得到的合成数据上进行 RLVR 可以提升广泛的感知基准表现，并进一步泛化到许多真实世界任务，包括具身空间推理、多模态智能体任务以及通用视觉推理。

paragraphs.en: Spatial perception. Spatial perception underpins embodied tasks such as robotic manipulation and embodied question answering ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Gemini Robotics Team, 2025 ) . Existing approaches use large-scale spatial supervision ( Chen et al., 2024a ) , intermediate visual grounding ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , and progressive training ( Li et al., 2026a ) . Benchmarks and associated training resources examine perspective-taking, multi-image inference, and multi-hop composition ( Li et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . MultihopSpatial additionally studies grounded spatial training and its transfer to embodied tasks ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . Euclid’s Gift ( Lian et al., 2026 ) demonstrates transfer from geometric surrogate tasks. Similarly, we train on a surrogate task and evaluate its transfer, but our task is built from natural images and targets the evidence connection shared by spatial perception and long-context understanding, rather than spatial skills alone.
paragraphs.zh: 空间感知。 空间感知是机器人操作和具身问答等具身任务的基础（Brohan et al., 2023；Kim et al., 2025；Gemini Robotics Team, 2025）。 现有方法采用大规模空间监督（Chen et al., 2024a）、中间视觉接地（Zhang et al., 2026a）以及渐进式训练（Li et al., 2026a）。 相关基准和训练资源考察视角转换、多图像推理和多跳组合（Li et al., 2025a；Yang et al., 2026）。 MultihopSpatial 还研究了有接地支撑的空间训练及其向具身任务的迁移（Lee et al., 2026）。 Euclid's Gift（Lian et al., 2026）展示了从几何代理任务出发的迁移能力。 类似地，我们也在一个代理任务上训练并评估其迁移效果，但我们的任务基于自然图像构建，目标是空间感知与长上下文理解共同依赖的证据连接，而不仅仅是空间技能本身。

paragraphs.en: Long-context multimodal understanding. Multimodal long-context understanding requires locating, tracking, and integrating evidence across long sequences of images and dialogue turns. Existing efforts support these abilities through multi-image and multi-turn instruction tuning ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) and dialogue-fragment retrieval ( Bi et al., 2026 ) , while benchmarks assess long-context integration and memory ( Song et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025d ; Ren et al., 2026 ) . Controlled studies nevertheless identify persistent difficulties in aggregating distributed visual information ( Das et al., 2026 ) . We target evidence connection as a shared component of these tasks, constructing single-image questions that require identifying, binding, and composing facts across regions. This setting makes the selected evidence easier to localize and audit, allowing us to investigate whether such supervision transfers to multimodal long-context understanding without training on long image sequences or dialogue histories.
paragraphs.zh: 长上下文多模态理解。 多模态长上下文理解需要在长序列的图像和对话轮次中定位、追踪并整合证据。 现有的工作通过多图像与多轮指令微调（Jiang et al., 2024；Huang et al., 2023；Liu et al., 2024）以及对话片段检索（Bi et al., 2026）来支持这些能力，同时有基准测试评估长上下文整合与记忆能力（Song et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025d；Ren et al., 2026）。 然而，受控研究仍然发现智能体在聚合分散的视觉信息方面存在持续性困难（Das et al., 2026）。 我们将证据连接作为这些任务的一个共同组成部分，构建单图像问题，要求在各个区域之间识别、绑定并组合事实。 这一设定使所选证据更易于定位和审查，使我们能够研究此类监督是否无需在长图像序列或对话历史上训练即可迁移到多模态长上下文理解。

paragraphs.en: Multimodal synthetic data. Early resources provide annotated scene graphs and programmatic questions ( Krishna et al., 2017 ; Hudson and Manning, 2019 ) . Later methods automate instruction generation ( Zhao et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) , evolution ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , and synthesis for unsupervised post-training ( Wei et al., 2025a ) . Zooming without Zooming ( Wei et al., 2026 ) transfers single-region supervision to full images with cross-model answer checks. CRIT ( Sung et al., 2026 ) and FM2DS ( Abaskohi et al., 2024 ) synthesize cross-modal questions and filter unimodal shortcuts, while MM-CondChain ( Shen et al., 2026 ) verifies conditional programs and ReasonVQA ( Tran et al., 2025 ) composes external knowledge paths. HopChain ( Wang et al., 2026 ) targets long-CoT robustness through instance-dependent chains with human-verified answers. Unlike these pipelines, EvidenceConnect builds each question on a coherent group of regions rather than a single region or a sequential chain, so its questions cover aggregation and closed-set comparison in addition to dependency chains. Moreover, it automatically checks both the answer and its dependence on the selected regions, through cross-model agreement and region ablation, without human annotation.

paragraphs.en: As discussed in Section 1 , fine-grained perception, spatial perception, and multimodal long-context understanding share a core capability that we call connecting evidence. This motivates training data whose questions structurally require this capability and end in concise answers suitable for verifiable rewards. To construct this supervision, we propose EvidenceConnect , a data synthesis framework centered on coherent groups of image regions. Within this framework, high-resolution privileged crops render local details visible for question synthesis, while cross-model answer anchoring and region ablation check label reliability and evidence dependence. The overview of the data synthesis pipeline is shown in Figure 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 如第1节所述，细粒度感知、空间感知和多模态长上下文理解共享一种核心能力，我们称之为证据连接。 这促使我们构建这样的训练数据：其问题在结构上需要这种能力，并以适合可验证奖励的简洁答案结尾。 为构建这种监督信号，我们提出 EvidenceConnect，一个以连贯的图像区域组为核心的数据合成框架。 在该框架中，高分辨率特权裁剪使局部细节可见以用于问题合成，同时跨模型答案锚定和区域消融用于检验标签可靠性与证据依赖性。 数据合成流程的总体概览如图2所示。

paragraphs.en: We first define the target question, whose answer depends on connecting one coherent group of regions in an image. Formally, from a source image I I , we obtain localized region proposals R I R_{I} and select one evidence group G = { r i 1 , … , r i k } ⊆ R I , 3 ≤ k ≤ 7 . G=\{r_{i_{1}},\ldots,r_{i_{k}}\}\subseteq R_{I},3\leq k\leq 7. Restricting the evidence to a single image keeps training inexpensive, while several related regions of one image already require a model to locate, bind, and compose dispersed evidence. Importantly, the regions are selected to jointly support one question q q , which assigns each of them a role, i.e., the fact it contributes: a value to be combined, a member of a closed candidate set, or a clue on which a later step depends.

paragraphs.en: Corresponding to these three kinds of roles, q q connects the regions through one of three forms. Aggregation combines counts or other numeric facts from the regions, possibly through a short calculation. Comparison and matching treats the regions as the complete candidate set, so that an answer such as an outlier, an extremum, or a pairing can be identified only by considering all of them. Dependency chains and compositions build the answer in several steps, e.g., by using a clue to decide what to read next, fixing a viewpoint for interpreting the rest, or combining predicates from different regions. In all three forms, the answer is determined only when the assigned roles are taken together. These forms also tie our questions to the target tasks: spatial relations, including those in an agent’s or object’s own frame, parallel spatial perception and embodied spatial reasoning, while binding facts to regions referenced by outline colors and integrating them parallels how long-context understanding and multimodal agents handle facts tied to image or turn references. To synthesize such questions, we first locate candidate regions, then group those that support one of the three forms, and finally compose questions over each selected group.
paragraphs.zh: 与这三种角色相对应，q q 通过三种形式之一连接各区域。 聚合将各区域中的计数或其他数值事实结合起来，可能通过一个简短的计算完成。 比较与匹配将这些区域视为完整的候选集合，因此诸如异常值、极值或配对这样的答案，只有通过考虑全部区域才能识别出来。 依赖链与组合通过多个步骤构建答案，例如利用线索决定接下来读取什么、为解释其余内容确定一个视点，或组合来自不同区域的谓词。 在所有三种形式中，只有把被指派的角色合在一起考虑，答案才能确定。 这些形式还将我们的问题与目标任务联系起来：空间关系，包括智能体或物体自身坐标系中的空间关系，对应并行空间感知与具身空间推理，同时将事实绑定到由轮廓颜色引用的区域并加以整合，类似于长上下文理解与多模态智能体处理与图像或轮次引用绑定的事实的方式。 为了合成这样的问题，我们首先定位候选区域，然后对支持三种形式之一的区域进行分组，最后在每个选定的组上构建问题。

paragraphs.en: Since multi-region questions need detail-rich scenes, we start from high-resolution, visually complex images. For each image, a strong VLM judges whether it can support such questions and, if so, is prompted to propose concrete, clearly localizable regions, each with a bounding box and a short description, prioritizing regions that can be related to one another over isolated salient ones. We then discard proposals that are too small, too large, or heavily overlapping. As these model-generated descriptions may be wrong, they only guide grouping and question writing, whereas reference answers are later derived from the image itself.
paragraphs.zh: 由于多区域问题需要细节丰富的场景，我们从高分辨率、视觉复杂的图像入手。 对每张图像，由一个强大的视觉语言模型（VLM）判断其能否支持此类问题；若能，则提示其提出具体的、可清晰定位的区域，每个区域附带一个边界框和简短描述，并优先选择彼此之间可以关联的区域，而非孤立显著的区域。 随后我们丢弃过小、过大或高度重叠的提议区域。 由于这些由模型生成的描述可能有误，它们仅用于指导分组和问题撰写，而参考答案稍后则从图像本身得出。

paragraphs.en: An arbitrary collection of these proposals, however, does not necessarily support a valid compositional question. We therefore prompt a strong model with the image caption and region descriptions to propose several groups per image, each labeled with a task family (a specific question type such as anomaly detection) and a necessity mode (how removing a region should affect the answer). We then discard invalid or duplicated groups and closed sets of incomparable objects, and keep groups with distinct task families first. The task family only guides question writing, whereas each region’s concrete role is fixed when a question is written.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，任意收集这些提案并不一定能支持一个有效的组合式问题。 因此，我们以图像标题和区域描述提示一个强模型，为每张图像提出若干分组，每个分组都标有任务族（一种特定的问题类型，如异常检测）和必要性模式（移除某个区域应如何影响答案）。 然后，我们丢弃无效或重复的分组以及不可比较对象的封闭集合，并优先保留具有不同任务族的分组。 任务族仅用于指导问题撰写，而每个区域的具体角色则在问题写出时即已固定。

paragraphs.en: Since fine-grained details are difficult to inspect at full-image scale, we construct for each group a privileged evidence layout V G V_{G} , which is accessible only during data construction. Following the layout-preserving design of Liu et al. (2025) , V G V_{G} arranges native-resolution crops of the selected regions, with small context margins, on a compact canvas that removes irrelevant background while preserving their relative horizontal and vertical order. In addition, each region is outlined in a distinct color that also marks it in the full image, allowing questions to refer to regions by color unambiguously. Finally, V G V_{G} serves as the sole visual input to the question generator, which confines its questions to evidence within the group, and it is later reused for verification (Section 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 由于在全图尺度下难以查看细粒度细节，我们为每个组构建一个特权证据布局 V G V_{G}，该布局仅在数据构建阶段可访问。 沿用 Liu 等人 (2025) 的保持布局的设计，V G V_{G} 将所选区域的原始分辨率裁剪（带有少量上下文边距）排列在一张紧凑的画布上，在去除无关背景的同时保留它们之间的相对水平和垂直顺序。 此外，每个区域都用一种独特的颜色勾勒出来，该颜色同时也在全图中标记该区域，使问题能够通过颜色无歧义地指代各个区域。 最后，V G V_{G} 作为问题生成器的唯一视觉输入，从而将其问题限制在组内证据范围内，且该布局随后被复用于验证（第 3.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: The question generator, a strong VLM, then receives V G V_{G} , the region descriptions, and a few reasoning blueprints, i.e., templates of reasoning programs, and composes several candidate questions, each with a concise answer: a single value (e.g., a number, a short phrase, or the outline color of a selected region), a set, or an ordered pair. To make its use of evidence checkable, the generator also states each region’s contribution and the answer expected after removing it, together with a reasoning certificate, i.e., a short sequence of steps that links the regions to the answer. Deterministic rules then reject candidates whose certificate leaves a region unused or contains steps that do not lead to the answer, whose own predicted answer survives the removal of a region, or that use subjective wording, leak the answer through an outline color, or contain inconsistent arithmetic. Implementation details and prompt templates appear in Appendices A and B .
paragraphs.zh: 问题生成器（一个强大的 VLM）随后接收 V G V_{G}、区域描述以及若干推理蓝图（即推理程序的模板），并生成多个候选问题，每个问题都有一个简明的答案：单个值（例如一个数字、一个短语，或所选区域的轮廓颜色）、一个集合，或一个有序对。 为了使其对证据的使用可被检验，生成器还会说明每个区域的贡献以及移除该区域后预期的答案，并附带一份推理证明（即一段简短的步骤序列，将各区域与答案联系起来）。 随后，确定性规则会拒绝以下候选问题：其证明中某个区域未被使用，或包含无法导向答案的步骤；其自身预测的答案在移除某个区域后仍然成立；或其使用主观措辞、通过轮廓颜色泄露答案，或含有不一致的算术运算。 实现细节与提示词模板见附录 A 和附录 B。

A candidate is kept only if a clear majority of each model’s responses supports the same answer and this answer becomes the reference a ⋆ a^{\star} .

paragraphs.en: Agreement on a ⋆ a^{\star} , however, does not show that the answer actually depends on the selected evidence. Since every question is constructed to require all of its regions (Section 3.1 ), an answer that survives the removal of a region indicates a defect, such as a decorative region or a shortcut that bypasses the intended reasoning. To detect such defects, we mask each r i ∈ G r_{i}\in G in the privileged layout, V G − i = ℳ i ​ ( V G ) V_{G}^{-i}=\mathcal{M}_{i}(V_{G}) , where ℳ i \mathcal{M}_{i} replaces the crop of r i r_{i} with a gray placeholder. A verifier from one anchoring family then answers q q from this view, reporting insufficient information if the masked evidence is needed, and either such a report or a changed answer confirms that the question depends on r i r_{i} . If instead a ⋆ a^{\star} is still returned, or the response is unusable, we query the verifier again and mark r i r_{i} as empirically redundant only if most queries recover a ⋆ a^{\star} . Note that a single redundant region, however, may reflect noise rather than a defect, because part of a masked region can remain visible in an adjacent crop through overlapping context margins, and individual responses also vary. We therefore reject a question only when more than one region is redundant, which also improves synthesis efficiency, since a stricter rule would discard many potentially valid questions merely because one region was judged redundant. The implementation details are shown in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: Table 2 compares EvidenceConnect with existing synthetic datasets on the same 4B base model. These datasets target single-region fine-grained perception (ZwZ), grounded counting and spatial reasoning (TVG), dialogue-fragment retrieval (F 2 RVLM), cross-modal multi-hop QA over interleaved contexts (CRIT), and knowledge-based multi-hop QA (MMHops). Training on TVG, F 2 RVLM, CRIT, or MMHops improves MileBench but degrades HR-Bench, CountQA, MindCube-Tiny, and MemLens, and all four datasets lower the average accuracy below that of the base model. In contrast, EvidenceConnect improves every benchmark over the base model and outperforms these four datasets on all 11 benchmarks, with a comparable amount of data (20.4K examples versus 19.4K–37K).
paragraphs.zh: 表2在相同的4B基座模型上将EvidenceConnect与现有合成数据集进行比较。 这些数据集分别面向单区域细粒度感知（ZwZ）、接地计数与空间推理（TVG）、对话片段检索（F 2 RVLM）、交错语境下的跨模态多跳问答（CRIT），以及基于知识的多跳问答（MMHops）。 在TVG、F 2 RVLM、CRIT或MMHops上训练虽能提升MileBench，却会降低HR-Bench、CountQA、MindCube-Tiny和MemLens的成绩，且这四个数据集均使平均准确率低于基座模型。 相比之下，EvidenceConnect在所有基准上都优于基座模型，并在全部11个基准上超越上述四个数据集，同时数据量相当（20.4K样本对19.4K–37K）。

paragraphs.en: ZwZ-73K is the strongest baseline. Since it also synthesizes questions from zoomed-in views but grounds each question in a single region, the comparison with ZwZ serves as an approximate ablation of connecting multiple regions. Although ZwZ uses 3.6 × \times as many examples (73K versus 20.4K), EvidenceConnect raises the average accuracy from 49.86 to 53.86 and surpasses ZwZ on 10 of the 11 benchmarks, trailing it only on MileBench by 0.13 points. The largest margin appears on MindCube-Tiny, where ZwZ reduces accuracy by 13.8 points whereas EvidenceConnect improves it by 5.4 points. This contrast is consistent with our premise that embodied spatial reasoning relies on connecting evidence across regions rather than on inspecting a single region.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate adaptive drop-one verification during data synthesis, we compare Qwen3.5-4B trained on 7K examples constructed with or without this verification step (Table 3 ). As described in Section 3.2 , this step masks one selected region at a time in the privileged layout and tests whether the reference answer remains recoverable. When the verifier returns the reference answer or an unusable response, additional queries are used; a region is marked as empirically redundant only if most queries recover the reference answer. A question is rejected only when more than one region is empirically redundant, allowing for noise from overlapping crop margins and variable verifier responses. With drop-one verification, average accuracy rises from 51.03 to 52.65 (+1.63 points), with improvements on 10 of the 11 benchmarks. The largest gains are on MindCube-Tiny (+5.15), O3-Bench (+4.64), and CountQA (+3.79), while ERQA decreases by 4.00 points. These results support the usefulness of this synthesis-time verification step for downstream performance, although its gains are not uniform across tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在数据合成过程中评估自适应逐项剔除验证的效果，我们对比了在使用与不使用该验证步骤构建的 7K 样本上训练的 Qwen3.5-4B（表 3）。 如第 3.2 节所述，该步骤在特权布局中每次遮蔽一个选定区域，并测试参考答案是否仍可恢复。 当验证器返回参考答案或不可用的响应时，会进行额外的查询；只有当大多数查询都能恢复参考答案时，该区域才被标记为经验性冗余。 只有当多于一个区域被判定为经验性冗余时，该问题才会被拒绝，以容忍重叠裁剪边缘和验证器响应多变所带来的噪声。 使用逐项剔除验证后，平均准确率从 51.03 提升至 52.65（+1.63 分），在 11 个基准中的 10 个上均有提升。 提升最大的是 MindCube-Tiny（+5.15）、O3-Bench（+4.64）和 CountQA（+3.79），而 ERQA 则下降了 4.00 分。 这些结果支持了这一合成时验证步骤对下游性能的有用性，尽管其收益在不同任务间并不一致。

paragraphs.en: To examine the role of privileged views, we train Qwen3.5-4B on 7K examples synthesized from privileged views or original images, with all other settings fixed (Table 3 ). Synthesis from privileged views achieves a higher average accuracy than synthesis from original images (52.65 versus 51.38), with higher scores on 9 of the 11 benchmarks. Original-image synthesis performs better on Chartography and ERQA, by 4.00 and 4.75 points, respectively. Thus, privileged-view synthesis improves average accuracy by 1.27 points in this 7K comparison, although its gains are not uniform across benchmarks.

paragraphs.en: Effect of training data scale. Figure 4 compares Qwen3.5-4B at different training data scales on the same 11 benchmarks. paragraphs.en: We presented EvidenceConnect , a fully automated framework that synthesizes multi-region visual questions and answers, requiring a model to connect evidence within an image. Trained with RLVR on these data alone, ZwZ2 improves over its base models on all 25 benchmarks at 4B, 9B, and 27B. Notably, although training uses only single images, the gains extend beyond fine-grained and spatial perception to embodied spatial reasoning, multimodal long-context understanding, and multimodal agent tasks. These results suggest that connecting evidence is a transferable training target, and thus tasks whose training data are costly to build can benefit from data that are far easier to construct and verify.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 EvidenceConnect，一个完全自动化的框架，用于合成多区域视觉问答数据，要求模型在图像内连接证据。 仅在这些数据上使用 RLVR 训练，ZwZ2 在 4B、9B 和 27B 规模下，于全部 25 个基准测试上都超越了其基础模型。 值得注意的是，尽管训练仅使用单张图像，但性能提升不仅延伸到细粒度与空间感知之外，还扩展到具身空间推理、多模态长上下文理解以及多模态智能体任务。 这些结果表明，连接证据是一个可迁移的训练目标，因此那些训练数据构建成本高昂的任务，可以从远易于构建和验证的数据中获益。

paragraphs.en: For each image, a single call with the image and its caption (Prompt B.1 ) judges whether the image can support multi-region questions and returns up to 18 region proposals, whose box coordinates are converted to pixels and clamped to the image. Images judged unsuitable, or with fewer than four remaining regions, are skipped.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每张图像，使用一次包含图像及其描述的调用（Prompt B.1）来判断该图像能否支持多区域问题，并返回最多 18 个区域提议，这些提议的框坐标会被转换为像素并限制在图像范围内。 随后我们丢弃覆盖图像面积少于 0.04% 或多于 18% 的框，以及与先前保留的框 IoU 不低于 0.65 的框。 被判定为不合适的图像，或剩余区域少于四个的图像，将被跳过。

paragraphs.en: A text-only call receives the caption together with the label and local description of each region, ranked by grounding confidence (Prompt B.1 ), and proposes up to six groups of 3–7 regions. Each group is annotated with one of 22 task families, which map to four necessity modes that refine the three question forms of Section 3.1 . Specifically, answer_sensitive covers aggregation (counting, numeric aggregation, and arithmetic), set_complete (filtering, anomaly, extremum, matching, and geometric, topological, or depth relations) and pair_complete (cross-region pairing) cover comparison and matching, and chain_dependency (OCR, spatial, viewpoint, conditional, Boolean, relational, and multi-hop chains) covers dependency chains and compositions. We keep groups whose region identifiers are valid, whose size lies in the allowed range, and that do not repeat an earlier group. In addition, the candidates of a filtering, anomaly, or extremum group must not mix coarse semantic classes, and groups with distinct task families are kept before groups that repeat a family.
paragraphs.zh: 纯文本调用会接收字幕以及每个区域的标签和局部描述（按定位置信度排序，见提示词 B.1），并最多提出六组、每组包含 3–7 个区域的分组方案。 每个分组都标注有 22 个任务族之一，这些任务族对应四种必要性模式，用以细化第 3.1 节中的三种问题形式。 具体而言，answer_sensitive 涵盖聚合（计数、数值聚合和算术运算），set_complete 涵盖筛选、异常、极值、匹配以及几何、拓扑或深度关系，pair_complete 涵盖比较与匹配中的跨区域配对，chain_dependency（OCR、空间、视角、条件、布尔、关系和多跳链）涵盖依赖链及其组合。 我们保留区域标识符有效、规模在允许范围内且不重复先前分组的分组。 此外，筛选、异常或极值分组的候选区域不得混用粗粒度语义类别，并且会先保留任务族各不相同的分组，再保留重复某一任务族的分组。

paragraphs.en: Each region is cropped at native resolution with a margin of 8% of its box size on every side. The crops are placed on a white canvas through an order-preserving remapping of each image axis, which removes the rows and columns not covered by any crop, and the canvas is uniformly downscaled only when its longer side exceeds 4096 pixels. Each region receives a distinct color from a seven-color palette, which bounds the group size at seven. The same colors are used in the question text, in the privileged and ablated layouts, and for the outlines on the marked policy view.
paragraphs.zh: 每个区域按原生分辨率裁剪，四周各留出相当于其边界框尺寸 8% 的边距。 裁剪结果通过保序方式沿图像两个轴重新映射放置到白色画布上，从而去除未被任何裁剪覆盖的行与列，且仅当画布较长边超过 4096 像素时才对其进行均匀下采样。 每个区域从七色调色板中获得一种不同颜色，这将组大小限制为七。 相同的颜色用于问题文本、特权与消融布局，以及标记策略视图上的轮廓。

paragraphs.en: For each group, the generator receives the privileged layout, the group metadata (labels, local descriptions, natural referents, box coordinates, and outline colors), four blueprints sampled from a library of 104 reasoning templates, and up to four additional free-form slots, and it returns up to eight candidates (Prompt B.1 ). The first blueprint follows the proposed task family when possible, and the remaining ones diversify answer forms and question types. Each candidate declares its question type, necessity mode, answer semantics (scalar, unordered set, or ordered pair), answer kind (outline color, number, Boolean pattern, semantic phrase, text, semantic set, or semantic pair), the contribution of every region, the predicted answer after removing each region, and a reasoning certificate. Open-vocabulary answers must contain fewer than ten words.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个分组，生成器接收特权布局、分组元数据（标签、局部描述、自然指称物、框坐标和轮廓颜色）、从104个推理模板库中采样的四个蓝图，以及最多四个额外的自由格式槽位，并返回最多八个候选（提示词B.1）。 第一个蓝图在可能的情况下遵循所提出的任务族，其余蓝图则用于多样化答案形式和问题类型。 每个候选需声明其问题类型、必要性模式、答案语义（标量、无序集合或有序对）、答案种类（轮廓颜色、数字、布尔模式、语义短语、文本、语义集合或语义对）、每个区域的贡献、移除每个区域后的预测答案，以及一个推理凭证。 开放词汇式答案必须少于十个词。

paragraphs.en: A certificate is valid only if every step reads from earlier steps alone, every selected region lies on a path to the output step, and no step is disconnected from it. Aggregation, arithmetic, and Boolean questions must further use an executable certificate with a restricted operator set. For aggregation questions, every region must receive a positive value, and the values must sum to the answer without all being one, since the answer would otherwise equal the number of outlined regions. Similarly, arithmetic expressions must reference every region and evaluate to the answer. We further reject candidates that expose region identifiers, do not refer to the marked regions, use conditional wording without explicit branches or outside conditional types, count vague background targets, request more than one output for a scalar answer, omit an explicit coordinate frame for spatial types, leak the answer through an outline color, use subjective phrasing, or declare an answer form that the answer does not match. Candidates whose own predicted answer after removing some region equals their proposed answer are rejected as well. The remaining candidates are ranked by the generator’s self-assessed naturalness, visual confidence, and multi-region scores, with bonuses for compositional types and non-numeric answers, and this ranking only determines which candidates proceed to verification. Per group, we keep up to four top-ranked candidates, preferring distinct question types and allowing at most one numeric and two outline-color answers. Per image, we keep up to eight candidates but always retain the best candidate of each question type.
paragraphs.zh: 证书只有在满足以下条件时才有效：每一步仅从更早的步骤读取信息，每个选定的区域都位于指向输出步骤的路径上，且没有任何步骤与之断开连接。 聚合、算术和布尔类问题还必须使用带有受限运算符集合的可执行证书。 对于聚合问题，每个区域都必须获得一个正值，且这些值之和必须等于答案，同时不能全为 1，否则答案将等于被圈出的区域的数量。 类似地，算术表达式必须引用每个区域，并且求值结果必须等于答案。 我们还会拒绝以下候选：暴露区域标识符的、未引用被标记区域的、在没有显式分支的情况下或在本不应使用条件句的类型中使用条件措辞的、把模糊的背景目标计入的、对标量答案请求多个输出的、对空间类型未给出显式坐标系的、通过圈线颜色泄露答案的、使用主观措辞的，或声明的答案形式与答案不匹配的。 候选中若自身在移除某个区域后得到的预测答案与其提出的答案相同，也会被拒绝。 剩余的候选按生成器的自评自然度、视觉置信度和多区域得分进行排序，并对组合类问题和非数值答案给予加分，该排序仅决定哪些候选进入验证阶段。 每组最多保留四个排名最高的候选，优先选择不同的问题类型，且最多允许一个数值答案和两个圈线颜色答案。 每张图像最多保留八个候选，但始终保留每种问题类型中最好的那个候选。

paragraphs.en: Each candidate is answered on the privileged layout by both anchoring families, with up to four samples per family and without the region descriptions or the generator’s answer (Prompt B.2 ). For closed-form questions, the prompt also lists the allowed answer labels, and we first draw two samples per family. Such a candidate is rejected early unless at least three of these four responses agree and each family contributes at least one of them. Responses are clustered by normalized string matching with numeric equivalence, and if the largest cluster has fewer than six members, the text-only judge re-clusters all responses by semantic equivalence (Prompt B.2 ). A candidate is accepted if the largest cluster is not an insufficiency response and contains at least three of the four responses from each family, and its answer then becomes a ⋆ a^{\star} . Finally, a ⋆ a^{\star} is re-checked against the answer-form constraints above.
paragraphs.zh: 每个候选答案都会在特权布局上由两个锚定族作答，每个族最多采样四次，且不提供区域描述或生成器的答案（Prompt B.2）。 对于封闭式问题，提示中还会列出允许的答案标签，并且我们首先为每个族抽取两个样本。 除非这四个回答中至少有三个一致，且每个族至少贡献其中一个，否则该候选答案会被提前拒绝。 回答通过带数值等价的归一化字符串匹配进行聚类，如果最大聚类的成员少于六个，纯文本裁判会按语义等价对所有回答重新聚类（Prompt B.2）。 如果最大聚类不是表示信息不足的回答，且包含来自每个族的四个回答中至少三个，则该候选答案被接受，其答案随之成为 a^{\star}。 最后，a^{\star} 会再次根据上述答案形式约束进行复核。

sents.zh: 对于封闭式问题，提示中还会列出允许的答案标签，并且我们首先为每个族抽取两个样本。

paragraphs.en: For each selected region, its crop in the privileged layout is replaced by a gray block with a red cross, while all other crops stay in place. The first anchoring family answers each ablated view once, with a mode-specific addendum to the answering prompt (Prompt B.2 ). If the response matches a ⋆ a^{\star} or cannot be parsed, the same view is queried twice more, and the region is redundant if at least two of its three responses match a ⋆ a^{\star} . A candidate is rejected if two or more of its regions are redundant.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个选定的区域，其在特权布局中的裁剪图像被替换为带红叉的灰色方块，而其他所有裁剪图像保持原位。 第一个锚定家族对每个消融视图回答一次，并在回答提示中附加特定于模式的补充说明（提示词 B.2）。 如果响应与 a^⋆ 匹配或无法解析，则对同一视图再查询两次；若其三次响应中至少有两次与 a^⋆ 匹配，则该区域是冗余的。 如果一个候选中有两个或更多区域是冗余的，则该候选被拒绝。

sents.zh: 如果响应与 a^⋆ 匹配或无法解析，则对同一视图再查询两次；若其三次响应中至少有两次与 a^⋆ 匹配，则该区域是冗余的。

sents.zh: 如果一个候选中有两个或更多区域是冗余的，则该候选被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Unmarked rewriting is attempted only for aggregate question types (object counts, attribute counts, and sums of visible numbers), whose answers do not depend on the outlines, whereas the answers of selection and pairing questions are often outline colors themselves. The first anchoring family rewrites the question for the unmarked image and proposes distractors (Prompt B.3 ), and rewrites that still mention boxes or outlines are discarded. Two audits from each family (Prompt B.3 ) must then all report unique references, task preservation, identifiable targets, multi-region dependence, and necessity of every evidence area. Each audit must also recover a ⋆ a^{\star} and ground exactly one box per intended region, and the grounded boxes must match the intended regions one-to-one, where a grounded box matches a region if its center lies inside the region’s box enlarged by 15%. Otherwise, the example keeps the marked policy view, on which the box of each selected region is outlined in its assigned color.
paragraphs.zh: 无标记改写仅针对聚合类问题（对象计数、属性计数以及可见数字求和）进行尝试，这类问题的答案不依赖于轮廓，而选择与配对问题的答案往往本身就是轮廓颜色。 第一个锚定家族为无标记图像改写问题并提出干扰项（Prompt B.3），仍提及框或轮廓的改写将被丢弃。 来自每个家族的两个审计（Prompt B.3）随后必须全部报告引用唯一性、任务保持性、目标可识别性、多区域依赖性以及每个证据区域的必要性。 每个审计还必须恢复一个 ⋆ a^{\star}，并为每个目标区域精确地定位出一个框，且定位出的框必须与目标区域一一对应；若定位框的中心位于目标区域框扩大 15% 后的范围之内，则视为该定位框与此区域匹配。 否则，该样例保留标记策略视图，在此视图中，每个被选区域的框均以其指定的颜色进行描边。

sents.zh: 每个审计还必须恢复一个 ⋆ a^{\star}，并为每个目标区域精确地定位出一个框，且定位出的框必须与目标区域一一对应；若定位框的中心位于目标区域框扩大 15% 后的范围之内，则视为该定位框与此区域匹配。

sents.en: Otherwise, the example keeps the marked policy view, on which the box of each selected region is outlined in its assigned color.
sents.zh: 否则，该样例保留标记策略视图，在此视图中，每个被选区域的框均以其指定的颜色进行描边。

paragraphs.en: For marked examples, the first anchoring family proposes three distractors given the marked image, the question, and a ⋆ a^{\star} (Prompt B.3 ), whereas unmarked examples reuse the distractors from the rewrite step. We remove empty distractors, distractors that match a ⋆ a^{\star} after normalization, duplicates, and, for closed-form answers, options outside the label vocabulary. If fewer than three distractors remain, we fill the missing options deterministically, for example with alternative subsets of set-valued answers, unused vocabulary labels, or neighboring integers for count answers. The four options are then shuffled, and the prompt asks for the option letter.
paragraphs.zh: 对于有标注的样例，第一个锚定族在给定标注图像、问题和 a^{\star} 的条件下提出三个干扰项（Prompt B.3），而无标注样例则复用改写步骤中的干扰项。 我们会移除空的干扰项、归一化后与 a^{\star} 匹配的干扰项、重复项，以及对于封闭式答案而言超出标签词表范围的选项。 如果剩余的干扰项少于三个，我们会以确定性的方式填补缺失的选项，例如使用集合型答案的替代子集、未使用的词表标签，或计数答案的相邻整数。 随后对四个选项进行打乱，并让提示词要求回答选项字母。

sents.zh: 对于有标注的样例，第一个锚定族在给定标注图像、问题和 a^{\star} 的条件下提出三个干扰项（Prompt B.3），而无标注样例则复用改写步骤中的干扰项。

sents.zh: 我们会移除空的干扰项、归一化后与 a^{\star} 匹配的干扰项、重复项，以及对于封闭式答案而言超出标签词表范围的选项。

sents.en: If fewer than three distractors remain, we fill the missing options deterministically, for example with alternative subsets of set-valued answers, unused vocabulary labels, or neighboring integers for count answers.
sents.zh: 如果剩余的干扰项少于三个，我们会以确定性的方式填补缺失的选项，例如使用集合型答案的替代子集、未使用的词表标签，或计数答案的相邻整数。

paragraphs.en: The screening model answers each example four times on its policy view (Prompt B.3 ). Examples with four correct responses or any unparseable response are discarded, and the remaining ones are labeled easy, medium, hard, or very hard when three, two, one, or none of the responses are correct. Finally, we keep at most four examples per source image, and each training example consists of the policy view and the multiple-choice question.
paragraphs.zh: 筛选模型在其策略视图上对每个示例回答四次（提示 B.3）。 四次回答全部正确或存在无法解析回答的示例会被丢弃，其余示例根据三次、两次、一次或零次回答正确分别标注为简单、中等、困难或非常困难。 最后，每张源图像最多保留四个示例，每个训练示例由策略视图和多项选择题组成。

sents.en: The screening model answers each example four times on its policy view (Prompt B.3 ).
sents.zh: 筛选模型在其策略视图上对每个示例回答四次（提示 B.3）。

paragraphs.en: Our training set contains 20.4K examples synthesized from SA-1B images by the pipeline in Section 3 and Appendix A , and Figure 7 summarizes its composition. Each example involves three to seven regions, most often three (65.74%) or four (24.34%), followed by five (7.93%) and six or seven (1.99%). The difficulty levels, defined by how many of the four screening responses are correct, are broadly distributed. Specifically, easy, medium, hard, and very hard examples account for 33.75%, 22.04%, 19.07%, and 25.14% of the data, so more than 44% of the examples are hard or very hard. Very hard examples, which the screening model never answers correctly, are kept, since their reference answers have already been anchored by two stronger VLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的训练集包含 20.4K 个由第 3 节和附录 A 中的流程从 SA-1B 图像合成的样本，图 7 总结了其构成。 每个样本涉及三到七个区域，最常见的是三个（65.74%）或四个（24.34%），其次是五个（7.93%）以及六个或七个（1.99%）。 难度级别由四项筛选回答中正确的数量定义，其分布较为广泛。 具体而言，简单、中等、困难和高难度样本分别占数据的 33.75%、22.04%、19.07% 和 25.14%，因此超过 44% 的样本属于困难或高难度。 筛选模型从未回答正确的高难度样本被予以保留，因为其参考答案已由两个更强的视觉语言模型锚定。

paragraphs.en: All models are trained with the same GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) configuration for two epochs, with a batch size of 128 and a learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} . paragraphs.en: To complement the quantitative evaluation, we examine three selected examples in which ZwZ2-4B answers correctly while its base model, Qwen3.5-4B, fails. Figure 8 presents examples from MIMIC, ZoomBench, and CountQA, covering cross-image category identification, spatially specified text recognition, and object counting. We analyze the models’ visible responses to identify how their answers differ in the use of visual evidence and the satisfaction of question constraints.

sents.en: Figure 8 presents examples from MIMIC, ZoomBench, and CountQA, covering cross-image category identification, spatially specified text recognition, and object counting.
sents.zh: 图 8 展示了来自 MIMIC、ZoomBench 和 CountQA 的样例，涵盖跨图像类别识别、指定空间位置的文本识别以及物体计数。

sents.en: We analyze the models’ visible responses to identify how their answers differ in the use of visual evidence and the satisfaction of question constraints.

paragraphs.en: In Figure 8 (a), the MIMIC question asks for a category that appears in all five images. The base model selects wine glass , even though its response explicitly acknowledges that this object is absent from some images. It justifies the answer by referring to the most prominent shared item across the majority of the set, effectively replacing the requirement of universal presence with majority overlap. ZwZ2 checks candidate categories against the full set of images. Its response rules out wine glass because it is absent from Images 4 and 5, and identifies person as the category shared by all five images. This example illustrates the importance of preserving the question’s scope when integrating evidence across images: an object shared by several images does not necessarily satisfy a constraint over the entire set.
paragraphs.zh: 在图 8 (a) 中，MIMIC 问题要求找出在全部五张图像中都出现的类别。 基础模型选择了 wine glass（酒杯），尽管其回答中明确承认该物体在某些图像中并不存在。 它通过引用该图像集合中大多数图像里最显著的共同物体来为答案辩护，实际上用「多数重叠」替代了「普遍存在」的要求。 ZwZ2 会针对完整的图像集合逐一核查候选类别。 其回答排除了 wine glass，因为它在图 4 和图 5 中不存在，并识别出 person（人）为全部五张图像共有的类别。 该示例说明了在跨图像整合证据时保持问题范围的重要性：被若干图像共享的物体未必满足针对整个集合的约束条件。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 (b) asks for the black text above the lower archway. The base model recognizes the word SEGATORI on the adjacent building, but associates the question with inscriptions on the fountain and ultimately selects FONTE . Its response therefore reveals a mismatch between the recognized text and the region specified by the question. ZwZ2 identifies the entrance of the yellow building as the relevant lower archway and reads the sign immediately above it, yielding the correct answer, SEGATORI . The case highlights the role of spatial reference resolution in visual text understanding: recognizing a visible word must be accompanied by establishing whether it belongs to the queried location.
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 (b) 要求识别下方拱门上方黑色文字。 基座模型能够识别相邻建筑上的单词 SEGATORI，但将该问题与喷泉上的铭文联系起来，最终选择了 FONTE。 因此，其回答暴露了所识别文本与问题所指定区域之间的不匹配。 ZwZ2 将黄色建筑的入口识别为相关的下方拱门，并读取其正上方的标牌，得出正确答案 SEGATORI。 该案例凸显了空间指代解析在视觉文本理解中的作用：识别可见单词的同时，还必须确定它是否属于被询问的位置。

paragraphs.en: In Figure 8 (c), the CountQA question asks for the number of tablets in a blister pack. The base model divides the image into regions above and below the yellow rubber band, reports two and four tablets, respectively, and returns 2 + 4 = 6 2+4=6 . Its arithmetic is consistent with these counts, so the error lies in enumerating the tablets. ZwZ2 describes the pack as two columns and five rows, counts five tablets in each column, and obtains the correct total of 5 + 5 = 10 5+5=10 . Here, the response uses the regular spatial arrangement to account for the complete set of tablets.
paragraphs.zh: 在图 8 (c) 中，CountQA 问题询问一板药片包装中药片的数量。 基座模型将图像划分为黄色橡皮筋上方和下方的区域，分别报告两片和四片药片，并给出 2 + 4 = 6 2+4=6 的结果。 其算术与这些计数一致，因此错误在于对药片的枚举。 ZwZ2 将该包装描述为两列五行，统计每列有五片药片，并得出正确的总数 5 + 5 = 10 5+5=10 。 在此例中，该回复利用规则的空间排列来清点全部药片。

paragraphs.en: Together, these cases reflect the steps of connecting evidence: integrating facts over the full set of images in (a), binding recognized text to the queried location in (b), and accounting for every instance before aggregating in (c).
paragraphs.zh: 这些案例共同体现了连接证据的步骤：(a) 中对全部图像集合进行事实整合，(b) 中将识别出的文本绑定到所查询的位置，(c) 中在聚合之前对所有实例进行核对。

paragraphs.en: Our work has two main limitations. First, although our single-image supervision transfers to multi-image and agent tasks, it does not directly model temporal or cross-frame dependencies, so extending the synthesis to evidence spread across video frames is a natural next step. Second, we apply RLVR to models of up to 27B parameters, and whether the same supervision benefits larger models or earlier training stages, such as pre-training, remains to be studied.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作存在两个主要局限性。 首先，尽管我们的单图监督能够迁移到多图像和智能体任务，但它并未直接建模时间或跨帧依赖关系，因此将合成扩展到分布于视频帧中的证据是一个自然的下一步。 其次，我们将 RLVR 应用于参数量最多达 27B 的模型，而同样的监督是否对更大的模型或更早的训练阶段（例如预训练）有益，仍有待研究。
